AVX2 unsigned 32-bit vector operations, loads, stores, conversions, and reductions.

# Purpose
This file defines the AVX `wu_t` vector API for eight packed unsigned 32-bit integers in a `__m256i` value. It provides constructors, lane exchange and broadcast helpers, aligned and unaligned load/store operations, element access, arithmetic, bitwise, logical, conditional, conversion, reduction, gather, and 8x8 transpose operations. Many operations use AVX intrinsics directly, while some use `static inline` functions to handle cases that need extra control, such as variable lane access, rotate operations, and unsigned conversions. The file is meant to be included through `fd_avx.h`, and it supplies the `wu` layer in the SIMD utility set.
